# rustboro-before-rival

Rustboro City at (16, 49), after the first badge and the PokéNav
(VAR_RUSTBORO_CITY_STATE 7). May stands directly below the player (16, 50),
half hidden behind the player sprite; pressing A talks to her (the same
encounter the row-53 trigger tiles start). The player's starter was Mudkip.
Party: Marshtomp L22 (re-saved; loses the battle to A-mashing with the
current build, so tests don't rely on winning).
